title: [CI][CUDA][Distributed] StageNegativeTest.test_shape_prop_mismatch  Works on 4-GPU runner but Fails on 8-GPU runner
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Tracking this in Umbrella Bug: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/162178

Job link:  https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17470577491/job/49628024441 

This unit test seems to be successful when running on a 4-GPU runner. But it fails to run on recently added 8-GPU runner (B200). 

ValueError: Number of microbatches (4) must be greater than or equal to the number of stages (8).

To execute this test, run the following from the base repo dir:
    python test/distributed/pipelining/test_stage.py StageNegativeTest.test_shape_prop_mismatch

For this purpose, I added https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/160803 require_exact_world_size(), so this test should be decorated with `require_exact_world_size(4)` to workaround this. Or someone please fix it so that it works with both 4-GPU and 8-GPU setting. 

### Versions

TOT should reproduce this. 
The version I used was based on pytorch commit: [145a3a7bda15e3963a33eb1b54bba5d4a270b225](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/commit/145a3a7bda15e3963a33eb1b54bba5d4a270b225)
